title: Kestrel Purchase Terms — Open Pre-Handover Order Cap
content:
**Clause 1 — the count.** For Vehicle Purchase Agreements, open pre-handover orders are counted across the customer's whole portfolio. The count includes only orders whose status is reserved or contracted. Orders that are return pending, delivered or completed, and orders in any closed state (cancelled, expired, returned), are not counted.

**Clause 2 — the cap.** The open pre-handover order cap is 2. A new reservation is accepted only when the count is below the cap. The count is read from the system record of the customer's orders and their statuses.

**Clause 3 — exchanges.** An exchange replacement reservation is counted like any other reservation, but the order being returned does not count because it is in return pending.

**Clause 4 — reaching the cap.** When the cap is reached, the customer must let a reservation lapse or cancel one before reserving another. The cap is never raised on request.

**Count and outcome.**

| Customer's orders in reserved or contracted at the moment of the request | New reservation |
|---|---|
| 0 | accepted (0 is below 2) |
| 1 | accepted (1 is below 2) |
| 2 | not accepted (2 is not below 2) |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- A customer holds one reserved order, one delivered order still inside its return window and one completed order. The count is 1, so a new reservation is accepted.
- A customer holds one contracted order and one order in return pending for an exchange, and asks to reserve the exchange replacement. The return-pending order is not counted; the count is 1 and the replacement reservation is accepted.
- A customer holds two reserved orders. The count is 2; the new reservation is not accepted while both remain open.
